title: LING
context: Yijun Deng and collaborators · The Place
paragraphs: A collaborative performance combining live moving graphics, sound, projection, stage lighting, fabric and clay, developed at The Place.
Directed by Yijun Deng. Jeanyoon Choi was a co-director and co-producer with Bryan Yueshen Wu and Chang Meng, and contributed visual programming with Bryan Yueshen Wu.
